label: Claude exposes 32 of 44 tracked commands because .claude/commands/create/skill.md collapses 13 files into one Skill entry, and the same file is mirrored into OpenCode's folder surface untested.
The same command has three native spellings: folder /create:readme on Claude and OpenCode, flat create-readme on Cursor, Codex and Pi, and no command surface at all on Devin.
No committed check measures per-runtime command visibility; the mirror check validates link shape only and covers two of six roots.

direction: Renaming the create ids to flat names across all runtimes
reason: Operator answer Q025 leaves the create ids as a recorded limitation; a visibility count and a spelling column reach the operational goal without the rename.

direction: Treating the OpenCode mirror as safe because its command syntax differs
reason: The mirror is built from the same canonical tree and includes the same skill.md; the syntax difference is a hypothesis, not a measurement.
